exposure: Indications for ACS (suspected preterm labor, preterm prelabor rupture of membranes, maternal indication, fetal indication, vaginal blood loss)
outcome: Time interval from ACS administration to delivery
Number of women not referred in time to a tertiary center
Delivery within 7 days of ACS administration
Delivery in a secondary hospital with gestational age less than 32 weeks
cohort: The study included 1375 women who received their first dose of antenatal corticosteroids between 24+0 and 32+0 weeks of gestation and/or delivered before 32 weeks of gestation from 2005 to 2010, across one perinatal center and nine referring hospitals.
finding: One-third of all women receiving antenatal corticosteroids delivered within 7 days, and half of those who received ACS in a secondary hospital were referred to a tertiary center, indicating potential for improvement in the timing of ACS administration and subsequent referral.
gest_age: 24+0 to 32+0 weeks of gestation (for ACS administration); delivered before 32 weeks of gestation
